items.description_en: Claude Code plugin that replaces the compaction summary with Jev decisions: every tool call and result is scored in one fast request, stale ones are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim.

items.name: DLSS5-Swapper
items.description_en: Install, tune and restore DLSS 5 in your games with one click. Native RenoDX, DLSS5-Feeder for games without DLSS, OptiScaler and multipass routes; DirectX 8/9/11/12, Vulkan, OpenGL, DirectDraw and emulators. In-game F8 overlay, automatic backups, and a community page showing what works on your games and your graphics card.
items.description_zh: 一键为游戏安装、调校和还原 DLSS 5。支持原生 RenoDX、面向不支持 DLSS 游戏的 DLSS5-Feeder、OptiScaler 与 multipass 路径，覆盖 DirectX 8/9/11/12、Vulkan、OpenGL、DirectDraw 及模拟器；内置 F8 浮层、自动备份和社区兼容性页面。
items.highlight_zh: 一键安装、调校与还原 DLSS 5
